//lastChange: Photographs on the generated pages (2026-09-08). pharmacy_assets already had kind in (logo, hero, gallery, service) and width/height columns, so the data model needed nothing; what was missing was that assetMapFor dropped kind and dimensions on the way to the renderer, so a generated page could not ask for "the hero photo" and could not emit width and height. Both now travel with the row. Alt text is generated from the pharmacy name and city — true and useful — and never describes what is in the frame, which nothing here has seen. The first photo loads eagerly and the rest lazily, because below-the-fold images spend a customer's data on what they may never scroll to.
